name: ucap
description: Universal (AI) Care Assistant & Platform: a self-hosted assistive and care platform for disabled people.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tools && tsc -p app
scripts.test:docker: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://ucap:ucap@db:5432/ucap_test core npm test
scripts.admin:invite: docker compose exec core node server/src/cli.ts admin-invite
